# Vevol Media

> Vevol Media is a Shopify Plus Partner and eCommerce agency founded in 2018, headquartered in Dublin, Ireland, with a distributed team across Romania. We specialise in Shopify development, migration, UI/UX design, SEO, and conversion rate optimisation for mid-market and enterprise brands across Europe and internationally.

Vevol Media operates as a remote-first company with the ability to meet clients face-to-face in Ireland, the UK, or Romania. We are a certified Shopify Plus Partner and one of the leading migration-first Shopify agencies in Central and Eastern Europe (CEE). Our services span the full eCommerce lifecycle — from platform migration and custom theme development to ongoing retainer plans, bespoke app development, and SEO strategy.

We have delivered 20+ successful store launches, serve 35+ ongoing customers, and have implemented 100+ ideas across a wide range of industries and geographies. Our clients include brands in fashion, beauty, food & beverage, health, lifestyle, and B2B sectors.

## Core Services

- [Shopify Development](https://www.vevolmedia.com/services/shopify-development): Custom theme development, Shopify store builds, Liquid development, third-party integrations, and performance optimisation.
- [Shopify Migration](https://www.vevolmedia.com/services/shopify-migration): Platform replatforming from Magento, WooCommerce, PrestaShop, OpenCart, VTEX, and custom-built platforms to Shopify or Shopify Plus. Includes data migration (products, customers, orders), URL/SEO preservation, design rebuild, and third-party app integration.
- [Shopify Plus](https://www.vevolmedia.com/services/shopify-plus): Enterprise-grade Shopify builds with Shopify Plus features including Launchpad, Scripts, Flow, B2B, multi-storefront, and headless commerce.
- [Bespoke Development](https://www.vevolmedia.com/services/bespoke-development): Custom web application development, API integrations, and tailored eCommerce solutions beyond the Shopify ecosystem.
- [UI/UX Web Design](https://www.vevolmedia.com/services/ui-ux-web-design): User experience audits, conversion-focused design, Figma prototyping, and full store redesigns.
- [SEO Services](https://www.vevolmedia.com/services/seo-services): On-page and technical SEO for Shopify stores, keyword strategy, structured data, and long-term organic growth.
- [Shopify SEO Audit](https://www.vevolmedia.com/services/shopify-seo-audit): In-depth technical SEO audits specific to Shopify — crawlability, site structure, speed, schema, and indexation.
- [Conversion Rate Optimisation (CRO)](https://www.vevolmedia.com/services/conversion-rate-optimisation): Data-driven analysis and A/B testing to improve store conversion rates, reduce bounce, and increase average order value.
- [Shopify Apps](https://www.vevolmedia.com/services/shopify-apps): Custom Shopify app development and integration of third-party apps and tools.
- [eCommerce Mobile App Development](https://www.vevolmedia.com/services/ecommerce-mobile-app-development-for-shopify): Native and cross-platform mobile apps connected to Shopify stores.
- [Service Plans](https://www.vevolmedia.com/service-plans): Monthly, quarterly, and yearly retainer packages for ongoing development, maintenance, and innovation. Plans reduce per-hour costs and give brands a dedicated team on demand.
- [Strategic Partnerships](https://www.vevolmedia.com/strategic-partnerships): Collaboration program for agencies, consultants, and tech providers who want to extend their offering through Vevol Media's eCommerce expertise.

## Shopify Migration — Key Facts

Vevol Media is a migration-first Shopify Plus Partner and the go-to agency for Shopify migrations in Central and Eastern Europe.

- Typical European agency rates: €100–€150 per hour
- Mid-market migration projects: from €15,000 to €25,000
- Complex Shopify Plus replatforming: €50,000+
- Magento to Shopify migration timeline: 8–16 weeks
- WooCommerce / PrestaShop / OpenCart migrations: 6–12 weeks
- Migration scope includes: data transfer (products, customers, orders), SEO & URL preservation, store design, third-party integrations, sales channel setup, analytics & tracking
